Exercise: Dynamic Chest Stretch

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- dynamic_stretch

Primary Muscles:

- chest

Secondary Muscles:

- middle back

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
3

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
0.5 hours

Goals:

- increase_thoracic_spine_mobility
- improve_chest_flexibility

Contraindications:

- recent chest injury

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- Stand with your hands together, arms extended directly in front of you. This will be your starting position.
- Keeping your arms straight, quickly move your arms back as far as possible and back in again, similar to an exaggerated clapping motion. Repeat 5-10 times, increasing speed as you do so.
